title: ichnanthus longiflorus
intro: Ichnanthus longiflorus, commonly known as the "Mazatec morning glory", is a plant species native to Mexico and Central America. It has been traditionally used in folk medicine for its potential health benefits, which include reducing anxiety and promoting relaxation due to its sedative and anxiolytic properties. The therapeutic actions of Ichnanthus longiflorus are attributed to its bioactive constituents, such as ergine, which is a psychoactive alkaloid, and other compounds that have been shown to possess anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties. The plant's bioactive constituents, including ergine and other alkaloids, contribute to its therapeutic effects, although further research is needed to fully understand its potential uses and benefits.
